title: Setup of Consumer Wearable Devices for Exposure and Health Monitoring in Population Studies
protocol: Launch the device automation application.
Navigate to the interface to build tasks.
Click the plus sign to add a macro or task.
Click on the plus sign on the trigger tab.
Select Date and Time, then select the Regular Interval tab.
Set a regular interval of 7.5 minutes and click OK.
Click on the plus sign on the action tab.
Select the Conditions/loops tab.
Select the IF clause.
Add a condition by clicking on the plus sign.
Select the Date and Time tab, then select Stopwatch.
Click on Ok.
Set a fixed duration to be added as a condition.
Check if the stopwatch value is >29 min or <1 s.
Select OR when setting conditions for the process to continue.
Click on End if and select Add action above.
Navigate to find the Screen tab and select Screen On.
Enable the screen when conditions are met.
Add an additional action that reduces the screen brightness to the lowest percentage.
Reset and restart the stopwatch used in this automated process.
Select Applications, then Launch Application.
Find and select the data collection application.
Select Force NEW to launch the application.
Trigger the process on screen activation.
Add an action by selecting IF Wi-Fi State is disabled.
Enable Wi-Fi if it is disabled.
Reset and restart Stopwatch_2 after enabling Wi-Fi.
Name and save the process.
Use the default screen deactivation as a trigger.
Set a condition that tests whether the smartwatch is not charging and is not connected to a network.
If both conditions apply, disable Wi-Fi connectivity to reduce battery consumption.
Set a condition that tests whether Bluetooth is enabled.
If Bluetooth is enabled, disable it to reduce battery consumption.
Automatically set screen brightness to 50% following the trigger.
Set a fixed time interval of 5 min.
Click on Ok to initiate the procedure.
Click on the plus sign on the Action tab.
Select Logging and click on Log Event.
Click the Ellipsis Points tab, find and select Wi-Fi SSID (Wi-Fi network name), then select Ok.
Repeat the process to add Wi-Fi signal strength, device serial number, GPS latitude, GPS longitude, accuracy of the GPS signal, and whether the smartwatch is charging or not.
Give a name to this process and select Save.
Set a condition in the Logging tab that tests if the smartwatch is not charging, the screen is turned off, and the stopwatch is >4 min.
Disable Wi-Fi when all these conditions are met.
Create a process that provides user notifications if the GPS signal is disabled.
Set an action that is automatically activated following the trigger.
Create a log event point similar to that in step 2.5.2.
Test whether the GPS sensor has been disabled.
Test whether the accuracy status of the GPS sensor has been changed.
Test whether airplane mode has been enabled.
Display the notification error "ERROR!!! Please check settings" if any condition is met.
Click on the Process tab.
Click on the Trigger tab.
Select Test trigger to initiate the actions of the process selected.
Export and save the files of the created processes in mdr format in the smartphone directory.
Transfer the files from the smartphone to a laptop/PC.
Connect the smartphone to the laptop/PC.
Find the directory with the extracted APK and mdr files on the smartphone.
Copy all the files into a directory in the laptop/PC.
Transfer the files from the laptop/PC to the smartwatch device.
Connect the smartwatch with the magnetic charger to the laptop/PC.
Select the option to transfer files on the smartwatch notification panel.
Navigate to the directory with the saved files from step 4.1.2 on the laptop/PC.
Copy all the files and paste them into a directory in the smartwatch.
Install the applications as well as the processes on the smartphone to the smartwatch.
Navigate to the destination with the pasted files, and install all the APK files including the application locker, tasker, and data collection application.
Install the mdr file that contains the processes created in step 2.
Accept all the permissions needed to operate the processes.
Swipe the smartwatch screen to left, navigate to the settings function, and click on Settings.
Select Sound, and disable all sounds by minimizing the volume levels of all individual sound settings.
Swipe the screen to the right to return to the main settings screen.
Swipe the screen to the right to return to the main settings screen.
Scroll down, select More, open the option Background Cleaner, and disable the Battery saver.
Swipe the screen to the right to return to the More settings screen.
Select the App freeze function, click on Next, scroll down, click on Google Play Store, and select Freeze.
Swipe the screen to the right to return to the More settings screen.
Select the Notifications function, select Google, and block all notifications from this application.
